required_condition: unit-normalization gate is present and identifies component combination as the next blocker
component-combination rule may use only the frozen source-side velocity components
any later combination must preserve velocity dimension and cannot introduce a fitted scale
combination policy cannot be selected from observed velocity, residuals, heldout score, or family winner
component operation class is declared only as a pre-scoring structural rule slot, not as a numeric formula
a later pre-scoring policy must declare allowed component weights, signs, and normalization before any combined anchor value exists
